text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, Fuji Kiseki was performing magic 
tricks for her juniors...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: When I focus my mind on the coin... Hup!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's gone?! Where did it go?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hmm, why, with my magic, of course—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oops... sorry. It seems like I'm out of 
mana for today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I'll show you the finest magic 
of all, so look forward to it, okay?♪"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... I ended up letting you down. 
That wasn't the kind of surprise I wanted 
to show you..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to entertain her junior, Fuji 
Kiseki felt down over her own 
inexperience.
